text_en: After the US PCE data, the three major US stock indexes opened higher collectively but closed mixed, with the S&P and Dow falling for a third straight session while the Nasdaq rebounded. Qiushi magazine published an important article by the General Secretary of the CPC Central Committee on October 1 titled "Strengthening Inclusive, Basic and Safety-Net Livelihood Development." China's official September PMIs both rose into expansion territory: manufacturing at 50.1 and non-manufacturing at 50.2. China's September RatingDog manufacturing PMI rose to a five-month high of 52.1, while the services PMI accelerated for a second straight month. After a change in statistical methodology, the core PCE price index, the Fed's preferred inflation gauge, rose 3% year-on-year in August, below expectations. US consumer spending in August posted the fastest growth in more than a year. The final estimate of US Q2 real GDP annualized quarter-on-quarter growth was revised up to 2.2%.
